chapterInfo.content:
6
AWURADE ne ne man asɛnnie
1 # Hes 6.2 Montie deɛ AWURADE ka ɛ:
Sɔre na bɔ wo nkuro wɔ mmepɔ anim,
na nkokoɔ ntie wo nne.
2Mmepɔ ne mo a mowɔ hɔ daa, asase nnyinasoɔ no, montie AWURADE nkurobɔ,
na AWURADE ne ne man anya ɔham,
na ɔne Israel bɛyi atɛn.
3 # Yer 2.5 Me man, ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ,
na ɛdeɛn na mede ahyɛ wo brɛ? Bua me ɛ!
4Na meyii wo firii Misraim asase so bae,
na megyee wo firii nkoafie,
na mesomaa Mose,
Aaron ne Miriam dii w’anim.
5 # Num 22.2—24.25; Yos 3.1—4.19 Me man, kae agyina a Moabhene Balak tuiɛ,
ne deɛ Beor ba Bileam de buaa no,
ɛfiri Sitim kɔduru Gilgal,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na woahunu AWURADE nsɛntenenee no.
Afɔrebɔ a ɛsɔ Onyankopɔn ani
6 # Yes 1.11; Amos 5.21-22 Ɛdeɛn na memfa memmra AWURADE anim
menkoto ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no?
Memfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ memmra n’anim,
ne nantwie mma a wɔadi afe afe?
7AWURADE ani bɛsɔ adwennini mpem ahodoɔ,
ngo sɛ asutene mpem du du?
Me mmarato nti memfa m’abakan memma,
anaasɛ me yafumma, me kra bɔne nti?
8 # Deut 10.12; 1 Sa 15.22 Wɔaka deɛ ɛyɛ akyerɛ wo, onipa,
ne deɛ AWURADE hwehwɛ no wo hɔ,
ɛnyɛ biribiara sɛ adeteneneeyɛ ne adɔeɛpɛ
ne ahobrɛaseɛ a wode ne wo Nyankopɔn nanteɛ.
9AWURADE nne refrɛ kuro no,
na wɔn a wɔsuro no no yɛ anyansafoɔ,
montie ntea ne deɛ ɔhyɛeɛ no.
10 # Amos 8.5 Amumuyɛ mu adenya da so wɔ omumuyɛfoɔ fie
ne efa a wɔahwan soɔ a wɔadome no?
11Na mɛbu deɛ ɔde nsania bɔne mu anaa fotoɔ
a nsisie abrammoɔ wɔ mu no bem anaa?
12Nhyɛsoɔ ayɛ emu adefoɔ amaama
na emufoɔ ka atorosɛm
na wɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ nnaadaa wɔn anomu.
13Na me nso mabɔ wo ama no abɔ wo yadeɛ,
wo bɔne nti na masɛe woɔ.
14Wo deɛ, wobɛdidi na woremmee,
na ɛkɔm fitaa bɛde wo;
na wobɛtwe wo nnesoa, na woremma no mfiri mu sɔnn;
na deɛ woma no firi mu no mpo, mede bɛma afena;
15 # Deut 28.38-40 wo deɛ, wobɛgu na worentwa;
wobɛkyi ngodua aba, na worensra ngo no,
na wobɛkyi nsamono, nanso worennom nsa no.
16 # 1 Ah 16.25, 29-33 Ɛfiri sɛ wodi Omri ahyɛdeɛ
ne Ahab fie nneyɛɛ nyinaa so,
na wonenam wɔn agyinatuo mu,
deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mayɛ wo ahodwirie ne emufoɔ no nso hwerɛmabɔ,
na woasoa me man ahohora.

pageProps.chapterText:
Montie deɛ AWURADE ka ɛ:
Sɔre na bɔ wo nkuro wɔ mmepɔ anim,
na nkokoɔ ntie wo nne.
Mmepɔ ne mo a mowɔ hɔ daa, asase nnyinasoɔ no, montie AWURADE nkurobɔ,
na AWURADE ne ne man anya ɔham,
na ɔne Israel bɛyi atɛn.
Me man, ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ,
na ɛdeɛn na mede ahyɛ wo brɛ? Bua me ɛ!
Na meyii wo firii Misraim asase so bae,
na megyee wo firii nkoafie,
na mesomaa Mose,
Aaron ne Miriam dii w’anim.
Me man, kae agyina a Moabhene Balak tuiɛ,
ne deɛ Beor ba Bileam de buaa no,
ɛfiri Sitim kɔduru Gilgal,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na woahunu AWURADE nsɛntenenee no.

Ɛdeɛn na memfa memmra AWURADE anim
menkoto ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no?
Memfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ memmra n’anim,
ne nantwie mma a wɔadi afe afe?
AWURADE ani bɛsɔ adwennini mpem ahodoɔ,
ngo sɛ asutene mpem du du?
Me mmarato nti memfa m’abakan memma,
anaasɛ me yafumma, me kra bɔne nti?
Wɔaka deɛ ɛyɛ akyerɛ wo, onipa,
ne deɛ AWURADE hwehwɛ no wo hɔ,
ɛnyɛ biribiara sɛ adeteneneeyɛ ne adɔeɛpɛ
ne ahobrɛaseɛ a wode ne wo Nyankopɔn nanteɛ.
AWURADE nne refrɛ kuro no,
na wɔn a wɔsuro no no yɛ anyansafoɔ,
montie ntea ne deɛ ɔhyɛeɛ no.
Amumuyɛ mu adenya da so wɔ omumuyɛfoɔ fie
ne efa a wɔahwan soɔ a wɔadome no?
Na mɛbu deɛ ɔde nsania bɔne mu anaa fotoɔ
a nsisie abrammoɔ wɔ mu no bem anaa?
Nhyɛsoɔ ayɛ emu adefoɔ amaama
na emufoɔ ka atorosɛm
na wɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ nnaadaa wɔn anomu.
Na me nso mabɔ wo ama no abɔ wo yadeɛ,
wo bɔne nti na masɛe woɔ.
Wo deɛ, wobɛdidi na woremmee,
na ɛkɔm fitaa bɛde wo;
na wobɛtwe wo nnesoa, na woremma no mfiri mu sɔnn;
na deɛ woma no firi mu no mpo, mede bɛma afena;
wo deɛ, wobɛgu na worentwa;
wobɛkyi ngodua aba, na worensra ngo no,
na wobɛkyi nsamono, nanso worennom nsa no.
Ɛfiri sɛ wodi Omri ahyɛdeɛ
ne Ahab fie nneyɛɛ nyinaa so,
na wonenam wɔn agyinatuo mu,
deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mayɛ wo ahodwirie ne emufoɔ no nso hwerɛmabɔ,
na woasoa me man ahohora.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
